level_basis: Red Alert - Extreme Heat Alert Day: city max temperature 47.0 C (measured at Ahmedabad airport station, WMO 42647 (NOAA GSOD)) against AMC thresholds (Yellow >= 41.1 C, Orange >= 43.1 C, Red >= 45.0 C; AMC Heat Action Plan 2019 (Easy Read), section IV.A 'Color Signals for Heat Alert', p.3). Context, not used for the level: HeatLens thermal-stress band Extreme; published-heatwave exposure tier heatwave.
city_ta_max_source: measured at Ahmedabad airport station, WMO 42647 (NOAA GSOD)

actions.title: Issue public awareness messages and hydration advisories
actions.detail: Send the fixed-template heat advisory (SMS / WhatsApp / CAP) for the affected zones.
actions.basis: AMC Heat Action Plan 2019 (Easy Read) section I: public messages via text messages, radio, social media and WhatsApp; SIH PS 26083 required-solution §3.4 (Yellow)

actions.title: Ask health facilities to check heat-illness readiness
actions.detail: Confirm ORS stock, cooling capacity and staffing for heat-illness presentations.

actions.title: Activate cooling centres and shelters
actions.detail: Open designated cooling centres in the affected zones for the forecast day.
actions.basis: AMC Heat Action Plan 2019 (Easy Read) p.5: the Nodal Officer "activates cooling centers, such as temples, public buildings, malls, during a heat alert"; SIH PS 26083 required-solution §3.4 (Orange)

actions.title: Stop mandatory outdoor work 11:00-16:00; offer shorter shifts
actions.detail: For platform/gig and outdoor workers: no mandatory work 11:00-16:00, shorter shifts, a 15-minute cooling break every 90 minutes, and drinking water provided.
actions.basis: NDMA gig-worker heat advisory (Mongabay India, Aug 2025), which applies during IMD Orange and Red heat alerts; SIH PS 26083 required-solution §3.4 (Orange), ref [26]

actions.title: Hospitals prepare for a rise in heat-illness cases
actions.detail: Pre-position staff and beds for heat-illness admissions on the forecast day.

actions.title: Apply maximum outdoor-work restrictions
actions.detail: Extend the Orange restrictions to the maximum permitted; outdoor work only where unavoidable.
actions.basis: SIH PS 26083 required-solution §3.4 (Red: all Orange actions plus maximum outdoor-work restrictions)

actions.title: Put emergency medical services on heat-illness readiness
actions.detail: Alert emergency medical services and hospital emergency departments.

actions.title: Notify the power utility to protect supply to hospitals and cooling centres
actions.detail: Machine-readable notice listing the affected zones and the forecast day. Actual grid action is decided by the utility.
actions.basis: SIH PS 26083 required-solution §3.4 (Red) and requirement R6; the document states utility-specific rules are to be agreed locally, so no published protocol is cited
